research_question: Can a small stock-data-first sleeve recover former V3-qualified names after a deep pullback and persistent sector-confirmed restart, without weakening V3's defensive core?
prior_evidence_disclosure: The July-August 2026 Shengyi Technology and JCET cases motivated the mechanism and are diagnostic holdouts, not untouched discovery data. Earlier same-day sector reranking and generic five-day transition sleeves failed. The wide replay interval has also been reused and is diagnostic rather than untouched.

data_contract.stock_bar_rule: unadjusted closes observed on or before the signal-day close
data_contract.execution_proxy: next available unadjusted close, matching the frozen V3 execution snapshot
data_contract.industry_mapping_rule: latest V3 inventory metadata observed on or before the signal day; never current static backfill
data_contract.available_at_rule: feature observation time <= signal-day close; execution occurs strictly after the signal day

candidate_memory.source: symbols observed in the personal-PIT-eligible V3 Top20 inventory on or before the signal day

confirmation: two-day cumulative return within the frozen variant interval
signal-day close above five-day simple moving average

sector_state.universe: currently tradable members of the causal V3 candidate-memory registry grouped by PIT-known SW2021 L1 mapping
confirmation: two-day sector return percentile across observed sectors >= variant threshold

selection.formula: 0.45*z(V3 memory quality) + 0.25*z(stock two-day return) + 0.20*z(sector two-day return percentile) + 0.10*z(shock depth)

evaluation.one_standard_error_rule: among tuning-and-validation risk-gate survivors with positive validation monthly delta, choose the smallest capital weight within one standard error of the best result, then prefer the stricter variant
evaluation.case_rule: the July-August pair diagnostic must reject the July 21 one-day bounce and may only identify a restart after two completed positive days; it cannot select thresholds or promote the strategy
